title: Toddler in Hooded Winter Coat by Brick Steps, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white outdoor snapshot dated March 1949, capturing a three-year-old toddler bundled up in a heavy double-breasted hooded jacket, matching pants, and light-colored shoes. The child stands proudly on a paved walkway in front of brick steps leading into a residential home. Annotations on the front margin read '3 yrs old' at the top and '3/49' at the bottom, capturing everyday middle-class suburban childhood in post-WWII America.
